wins.label: Record Q3 revenue and exceptional growth
wins.evidence: Revenue of $35.1 billion was up 17% sequentially and up 94% year-on-year and well above our outlook of $32.5 billion

wins.label: Blackwell exceeding previous estimates
wins.evidence: we will deliver this quarter more Blackwells than we had previously estimated and we are on track to exceed our previous Blackwell revenue estimate of several billion dollars

wins.label: Data Center dominance with 112% YoY growth
wins.evidence: Data Center revenue of $30.8 billion, up 17% sequential and up 112% year-on-year

wins.label: Multiple scaling paths driving sustained demand
wins.evidence: we now have 3 ways of scaling...pretraining scaling, post-training scaling, and inference time scaling...the demand for our infrastructure is really great

wins.label: Enterprise AI and agentic AI adoption accelerating
wins.evidence: Nearly 1,000 companies are using NVIDIA NIM, and we expect NVIDIA AI enterprise full year revenue to increase over 2x from last year

risks.label: Gross margin compression during Blackwell ramp
risks.evidence: As Blackwell ramps, we expect gross margins to moderate to the low 70s...GAAP and non-GAAP gross margins are expected to be 73% and 73.5%

risks.label: Gaming supply constraints impacting Q4
risks.evidence: we expect fourth quarter revenue to decline sequentially due to supply constraints

risks.label: China market competitive and export-controlled
risks.evidence: We expect the market in China to remain very competitive going forward...As a percentage of total data center revenue, it remained well below levels prior to the onset of export controls

risks.label: Complex Blackwell customization and integration risks
risks.evidence: Blackwell is a customizable AI infrastructure with 7 different types of NVIDIA-built chips...The integration of all of those systems into the world's data centers is nothing short of a miracle

risks.label: Potential digestion phase uncertainty
risks.evidence: historically, when we have seen hardware deployment cycles, they have inevitably included some digestion along the way
